_: john_wick_pro on JPSalas & marty's 'John Wick' 3.0 (the 'John_Wick_Legend' pack, PAD-905),
a SCRIPTED tribute (JPSalas's template: missions, jackpots; LoadEM, SolLFlipper/
SolRFlipper, plungerIM) on Stern's John Wick playfield art: fitted to the rig's
drawing on fifteen switches (lanes, ramp targets, the pop and its targets, the VUK)
at an rms of 17 table units (x = 3.313 dx + 0.016 dy - 56.8, y = 0.144 dx + 3.477 dy - 222.2).
The lower half is the machine's; the top is the table's own: its center ramp
climbs past the diverter to the arch, its right ramp hops the ball onto the return
wire (Kramploop), the VUK and the crate are teleports (Krampcoude, Kexitcoffre).
The machine's switches with no object here are left out: POP TARGET 6/7, POP ENTER
and the flipper EOS. Mission triggers the shadow game keeps disabled are made live
where they are the machine's (the skill shot), and the life-ring target solid.
PAD-922: the Continental (CAPTIVE BALL TGT) is the self-kicking hole at its mouth (lock), and the
car (CAR HIT OPTO) a trigger added on its nose, the invisible wall the ball meets in front of
the table's car (retrofit_triggers); the captive ball top right is the table's own.
Pro is preferred: the table's car does not move and its lock is scripted; the
Pro has neither (its locks are virtual), nor the drop target at the pops.
PAD-1098: the table's own arch lock stays shut (checkarche quiet, its KArche CreateBalls
neutered): with three ramp diamonds lit (the machine's lights now) it swung the diverter open,
destroyed the ball at Karche and made one behind lockarche that nothing ever lets go.

sw5.name: LEFT ORBIT (the left orbit's lane across the top)

Gate001.name: CENTER RAMP EXIT OPTO (the gate where the center ramp turns right, past the diverter)

saucers._: kicker -> the switch it holds and how the coil kicks it out (dir, power[, kickz]); kick_from: the kicker the ball leaves by (the table's own teleport exit); stack: the switches behind it (a lock lane); held_ms: a post the game holds down

Krampcoude.name: RIGHT VUK OPTO (up onto the right return wire, as the table's own)
